prompt: How many Los Angeles Metro Rail stations are served by both the A Line and at least one other Metro Rail line?
answer: 7 stations. These are the five shared by the A and E lines—Pico, 7th/Metro, Grand Av Arts/Bunker Hill, Historic Broadway, and Little Tokyo/Arts District—plus Union Station (B and D lines) and Willowbrook/Rosa Parks (C Line).
